decision_conditions: At present, the application is invalid. You have indicated that the proposed works are to trees within a conservation area only. However, it has come to the Council’s attention that one of the trees included in the application, T2: Silver Birch, is subject to a Tree Preservation Order (TPO). As TPO trees require a separate application under TPO regulations, T2 will be removed from the current Section 211 notification. To proceed with works to this tree, you will need to submit a new TPO tree work application.
description:
